description: This PHP source file defines the SaveProjectController class responsible for handling project save operations within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It manages rendering the project save/edit component and checks user permissions and project existence.

classes.name: SaveProjectController
classes.description: Controller class for saving or editing projects within the OrangeHRM Time plugin, handling permissions, component rendering, and validation of project records.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view component based on whether a project ID is present; sets unselectable activity IDs and project ID for editing, or initializes a save component for new projects.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission and access to the project specified by ID; throws an exception if the project does not exist.
